question:
**Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.**

To take after
solution:
The correct answer is** 'To be similar in appearance'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate meaning of the given idiom** 'To take after'** is **'To be similar in appearance'.**
 
• **To take after:** to be similar to an older member of your family in appearance or character. (दिखने या चरित्र में अपने परिवार के किसी बड़े सदस्य के समान होना)
 
 
• *Example: He **takes after** his mother/his mother's side of the family.*

 
 
 

**Correct Answer:__** *To be similar in appearance.*
